newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel drops on Norscan stocks hike.
newsitem.headline: Portucel drops on Norscan stocks hike.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese pulp group Portucel Industrial fell on news that North American/Scandinavian Norscan pulp inventories rose by 185,000 tonnes in November, dealers said.
"The Norscan news has pressured Portucel shares," said one dealer who asked not to be identified.
Portucel stood at 890 escudos, down 25, in volume of 93,040 shares at 1255 GMT.
"With support at 900 escudos broken, things could get complicated, because the next resistance level is 850, which is very low," another dealer said.
